name: Island Plan: The Isle of Wight Core Strategy and DM Policies DPD

housing-numbers.notes: Strategy provides for 8,320 dwellings 2011-2027 at 520 dwellings per year. 3,200 existing permissions and 5,120 additional dwellings required through Area Action Plans and smaller-scale development. Windfall sites from 2021 onwards estimated at 700 dwellings. No specific site allocations made - housing to be delivered through subsequent Area Action Plans for Key Regeneration Areas.
